name: task-band
description: The band above the prompt from ponytail, on its own: task cost, tokens, agent time, code reuse and tests, plus a local board of every task.

ledger.title: Task board
ledger.description: After every turn, write this task's row (cost, turns, agent time, tokens, reuse, tests) to ~/.config/task-band/<project>.csv for the board.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional: an https address that gets this task's row as JSON after every turn. Empty: nothing leaves this machine.

webhookToken.title: Webhook token
webhookToken.description: Optional: sent to the webhook as a Bearer token. Kept in the system keychain.

sendNames.title: Send task names
sendNames.description: Send each task's name to the webhook.
